successors.name: Indus Valley Civilisation
successors.text: the Hakra paleochannel of the Ghaggar-Hakra: "the earliest dated Hakra Ware is at Cholistan" (Bahawalpur stands in for it), Bhirrana and other sites in Haryana (Sirsa stands in for Fatehabad), and…

ledger.x: 3500 BCE: the Hakra Ware villages of the Ghaggar-Hakra valley (Cholistan, Haryana, Pakistani Punjab) appear: "One estimate is 3500-3100/3000 BCE"; the page gives other, much earlier dates for Bhirrana.

3000 BCE: the Hakra Ware ends in the late fourth millennium BCE ("at least from early 6th to late 4th millennium B.C."); Kot Diji follows, but the Indus dossier does not draw the Ghaggar-Hakra country until 2800.

certainty.note: Known from scattered sites along a dry river; no frontier is recorded.
